remarks: Beautifully renovated cottage on lovely grounds, walking distance to the beach. Every detail of the remodel is well-thought-out, charming and with all the modern amenities. Original stone fireplace in the living room/dining area. Everything else is new and improved! Central air throughout. Gorgeous kitchen with stainless steel appliances. High-end bathrooms, new light fixtures, ceiling fans, fresh paint, washer and dryer, on-demand hot water. There's a private patio to enjoy the outdoors. The location is spectacular: walking distance to parks, beaches, shopping, and dining; a few minutes drive to I-95, close to downtown and the Stamford railroad station.
